# Cohen & McMullen, P.A.

> Boutique law firm for complex litigation and criminal defense. Offices: 1132 SE 3rd Avenue, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316 and 745 Fifth Avenue, Suite 500, New York, NY 10151; Los Angeles location being opened. Phone (954) 523-7774, toll-free (888) COHEN-LAW, email info@floridajusticefirm.com. Free case evaluation. Motto: “Si vis pacem, para bellum” (If you want peace, prepare for war).

## Practice areas
- [Criminal Defense](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/criminal-defense/): If you are under investigation or have been charged, stop talking to investigators and call a defense attorney. Cohen & McMullen, P.A. tries criminal cases in Florida state court and federal court, from misdemeanors to serious felonies.
- [Commercial Litigation](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/commercial-litigation/): Commercial litigation covers lawsuits between businesses, owners and partners: breach of contract, shareholder and partnership disputes, and business torts. Cohen & McMullen, P.A. litigates these cases in Florida and New York and is built to challenge large corporations.
- [Contracts & Corporate Formation](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/contracts-corporate-formation/): The best contract is one that is never litigated. Cohen & McMullen, P.A. drafts, negotiates and reviews agreements and forms companies for businesses and individuals throughout Florida, with trial lawyers who know how contracts fail in court.
- [Wrongful Death](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/wrongful-death/): A wrongful death claim holds a person or company accountable when their negligence or misconduct causes a death. In Florida the claim is brought by the personal representative of the estate on behalf of the family, and strict filing deadlines apply, so families should speak with an attorney early.
- [Catastrophic Injury](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/catastrophic-injury/): A catastrophic injury is one that permanently changes a person’s life, such as a brain or spinal cord injury, amputation or severe burns. If another person’s negligence or misconduct caused it, you may be entitled to compensation for medical care, lost income and future needs.
- [Products Liability](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/products-liability/): A products liability claim seeks compensation from the companies that design, make, distribute or sell a product that injures someone because it was defective. Keep the product, its packaging and your receipts, and speak with an attorney before returning or discarding anything.

Education: J.D., University of Miami School of Law; B.S.B.A. in Finance, University of Central Florida. Admissions: The Florida Bar.
- [Andrew B. Courtney](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/andrew-courtney/), Partner: Former lead felony prosecutor in Broward County. Now he defends. Education: J.D., Nova Southeastern University, Shepard Broad College of Law; B.S., Criminal Justice and Writing, University of Scranton. Admissions: The Florida Bar; District of Columbia Bar.
- [Ethan J. Strauss](https://www.cohenandmcmullen.com/ethan-strauss/), Associate: Summa cum laude, Nova Law Review, and former judicial intern. Personal injury, commercial litigation and defense. Education: J.D., summa cum laude, Nova Southeastern University, Shepard Broad College of Law; B.S. in Finance, University of South Florida. Admissions: The Florida Bar.
